dispute_ticket.description: I agreed to the road he named, but he says himself he went a different way. The fare was much higher than the estimate.
dispute_ticket.driver_statement: I asked the rider about going via Ubi Avenue 2 and the rider agreed. In the end I went by Jalan Eunos instead because it looked clearer; same direction.

chat_logs.message: Jam on Kallang Paya Lebar Expressway is building up ahead, can I go round via Ubi Avenue 2?
